gaps.topic: Actual drum profile and exterior displacement
gaps.action: Measure the chosen drums and replace the ideal-cylinder proxy.
Verify native CAD or drawing geometry; retain display coordinates as assumptions until then.

gaps.topic: As-built masses and centers of gravity
gaps.action: Weigh the assembly/components and establish loaded CG. Until then label movable-load scenarios approximate.
Obtain reviewed load limits; displacement calculations never authorize test payloads.
Begin with labeled scenario coefficients; calibrate drag, damping and response against controlled tests.

gaps.topic: Motor/steering and 12 V versus 24 V configuration
gaps.action: Select a consistent propulsion and power configuration before claiming powered fidelity.
Measure thrust/current maps and usable energy; voltage and amp-hours alone do not establish endurance.
Distinguish shore-link, local-bus and positioning failures; define available control and recovery actions.
Choose rigid, articulated or separate vessels and identify powered/passive modules before modeling a convoy.

limits: This is a provisional simulation baseline, not a fabrication release or measured vessel model.
The Phase 1 calculation is level-trim, equal-loading hydrostatics for ideal horizontal cylinders.
Drum crown clearance is not deck freeboard. Full-immersion displacement is not a payload rating.
Center-of-gravity, roll/trim equilibrium, righting arms, structure and damaged flotation are not solved here.
Wave rendering, propulsion, autonomy and hardware integration belong to later phases.
